decision_conditions: The submitted drawings fail to accurately demonstrate the existing and proposed ridge relationships with adjoining properties and therefore the applicant has failed to satisfactorily demonstrate the resultant scale, bulk and prominence of the proposed roof enlargement. Consequently, the applicant has failed to demonstrate that the development would appear as a subordinate addition that preserves the character and appearance of the host dwelling and surrounding terrace. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy 53 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024) and the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD.

By reason of its scale, bulk and increased roof height, the proposed development would appear as an overly prominent and unsympathetic addition that would fail to remain subordinate to the host dwelling or preserve the character and appearance of the terrace and surrounding street scene. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy 53 of the Waltham Forest Local Plan Part 1 (2024) and the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD.
description: Increase of height to the ridge facilitating the construction of a dormer roof extension to the main rear roof, including an extension above the two storey rear projection, with installation of two roof lights to front roof slope.
